rule: All P11/T6 paths in the isolated binding treat legacy publication as immutable: new unmarked orders reuse it or fail closed; no regeneration from newer masters
minimal_fix: One branch in existing mvb_prepare_delivery overlay; no catalogue or checkout change
regression_gate: Six new checks: P11/T6 unmarked order does not modify old bytes; older orders download original after new order; missing legacy snapshot is not regenerated
prior_59_receipt_status: Historical limited coverage retained; not sufficient for cross-order preservation and superseded by v2 for current code
why_rechecked: Runtime overlay changed to correct observed defect; complete isolated suite rerun only for changed code, not old Office/PDF/model/product jobs
